system.description: Grimoire (400j). Requires: 1 hour, 10 Spell Uses. Lasts: Until Recast. The radiating temperature of a small object becomes scalding hot or freezing cold. Most commonly used on rocks to boil water in Dwarven water rooms. Cast from a book: not usable in combat; Skimpy armour or none; if the caster joins combat the spell is interrupted.
